mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 2.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 0.5% MoM and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 2.0%, stagflation risk triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a housing starts (HOUST) decline exceeding 0.5% MoM signals housing sector weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production (INDPRO) decline exceeding 0.5% MoM indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) increase exceeding 1.0% MoM signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST increases by more than 1.0% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) coincides with strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 0.3% MoM), robust economic expansion drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM and RSAFS growth exceeds 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decline exceeding 0.2pp MoM signals unexpected monetary easing, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.2pp MoM.
